items.name: Brogan's Pick-Charm
items.lore: A tiny silver pick on a thong. Every lurikeen miner wears one. Brogan had a spare.

items.name: Ore-Cart Bracer
items.lore: Cart iron, bent round a wrist. It has pushed a lot of ore.

items.name: Glamour-Ring of the Siog
items.lore: Cucugar's glamour-ring, its spell broken. It still makes your fingers itch.

items.name: Lamp-Bearer's Belt
items.lore: A miner's lamp-belt. The lamp is long gone. The belt is very good.

items.name: Fence's Tally-Stick Charm
items.lore: A siog fence's tally-stick: ore in, silver out. The last notch is very deep.

items.name: Ranger-Issue Ring
items.lore: A plain ring, issued at Druim Cain to rangers who bring in good word.

items.name: Camp-Stalker's Sash
items.lore: Dark green, for creeping round a siog camp at night.

items.name: Sloithi's Ore-Crown
items.lore: A crown of raw ore the siog chief wore. It weighs about as much as a goat.

items.name: Mine-Mouth Bracer
items.lore: Iron from the mine's own gate.

items.name: Deep-Seam Ring
items.lore: Silver from the deepest seam, where the lurikeen say the hill sings.

items.name: Dying-Oak Leaf Charm
items.lore: An oak leaf from the grove, gone brown in midsummer.

items.name: Grove-Watcher's Ring
items.lore: A ring of plaited oak root.

items.name: Oak-Heart Acorn
items.lore: A golden acorn from the heart of a sacred grove. It's warm, like something sleeping.

items.name: Siog Thief's Ring
items.lore: The siog steal everything that isn't nailed down. This ring was stolen eleven times.

items.name: Renegade Druid Torc
items.lore: A druid's torc, from a druid who forgot what druids are for.

items.name: Grove-Keeper's Mantle
items.lore: Green and brown, the colours of a grove that lives.

items.name: Replanted-Oak Bracer
items.lore: Oak bark, freshly grown. It smells of rain.

items.name: Thorn-Hound's Collar Ring
items.lore: Cut from a thorn-bound hound's collar. The thorns are dead now.

items.name: Ruadh's Black-Feather Cloak
items.lore: Black feathers, every one from a crow that was paid to give it.

items.name: Wind-Charm Pendant
items.lore: A broken wind-charm, yew and scarlet thread. It doesn't hum any more.

items.name: Caille Courier's Belt
items.lore: The Muintir's couriers wear these between Caille and the hill.

items.name: Veil-Thread Bracelet
items.lore: A thread from the veil between worlds. It's very hard to see.

items.name: Otherworld Apple Charm
items.lore: An apple from beyond the veil, cast in gold. Don't eat it. It's gold.

items.name: Seven-Year Ring
items.lore: Rian's ring. It fit him when he was ten.

items.name: Wisp-Light Cloak
items.lore: It glimmers faintly, like a veil wisp at the edge of sight.

items.name: Trampled-Fence Bracer
items.lore: Fence-iron from Tuathal's pasture, bent by a fairy horse.

items.name: Scarlet-Thread Charm
items.lore: A scarlet thread off a rider's sleeve, knotted round a hoof-nail.

items.name: Rider's Green-Gold Belt
items.lore: Green leather worked with gold. It belonged to someone who's been riding for a thousand years.

items.name: Host-Message Ring
items.lore: The ring the rider carried his message in. It's hollow, and it hums.

items.name: Fairy-Steed Bridle Charm
items.lore: Silver bells on a green bridle. They ring when nothing moves them.

items.name: Blademaster's Riding Gauntlet
items.lore: Twenty years in the host's saddle wore it thin. It's still a fine gauntlet.

items.name: Mortal Champion's Torc
items.lore: The torc he wore when the host took him. It's out of fashion by about twenty years.

items.name: Golden-Hall Dream Charm
items.lore: Aideen's drawing of the hall she dreams of, folded small. The doors are exactly right.

items.name: Wing-Scale Ring
items.lore: A single scarlet wing-scale, set in silver. It's warm.

items.name: Menhir-Shelter Bracer
items.lore: Stone dust from the lake's menhir, bound in leather. Wind doesn't seem to reach you as hard.

items.name: Wrath-Sprite's Ember Ring
items.lore: A wrath sprite's spark, gone dim and warm.

items.name: Gale-Torn Belt
items.lore: Shredded by a wind out of a clear sky.

items.name: Lusmorebane's Foxglove Crown
items.lore: Foxgloves that never wilt, woven by the changelings' king. Lusmore was the man they gave a hump to. This was the one who did it.

items.name: Aideen's Ribbon Bracer
items.lore: Aideen's scarlet ribbon, wrapped round a bracer. She insisted.

items.name: Cradle-Ash Ring
items.lore: Cut from the changelings' cradle, burned and scrubbed clean.

items.name: Riocard's Yew Wand
items.lore: Riocard's wand, broken or not as you chose. Yew, bound in scarlet thread, still faintly cold.

items.name: Bresal's-Heir Torc
items.lore: Riocard's torc. He thought he was the heir of Bresal the druid. He was right, unfortunately.

items.name: Circle-Breaker Ring
items.lore: A shard of the binding-stone, set in bronze.

items.name: Etain's Third-Life Cloak
items.lore: Scarlet and gold. Aideen wove it for you herself, whichever she chose.

items.name: Hall-Under-the-Hill Ring
items.lore: Gold, warm, and humming with music.

items.name: Weaver's-Daughter Belt
items.lore: Brynach weaving, Nessa's best. Undyed, like a herder's.

items.name: Waylayer's Mask Charm
items.lore: A siog waylayer's face-mask. It smells of old cheese and older fear.

items.name: Road-Ranger's Ring
items.lore: Issued at Druim Cain to rangers who keep the road open.

items.name: Tower-Watch Bracer
items.lore: From Giolladhe's Tower's own watch. Dented on every side.

items.name: Rage-Wolf Pelt Cloak
items.lore: A rage wolf's pelt. It still bristles in a fight.

items.name: Hunting-Horn Charm
items.lore: A Wild Hunt horn, cracked. It still sounds, very faintly, if you listen.

items.name: Mikka's Champion Torc
items.lore: The host's champion wore this a thousand years. You've been warned: it's heavy.

items.name: Host-Champion's Bracer
items.lore: Gold and green, with a scarlet thread round the wrist.

items.name: Unhorsed Ring
items.lore: A ring Mikka dropped when you put him in the grass.

items.name: Forest-Gate Scout's Belt
items.lore: Rowan-marked, so the Queen's people won't touch the wearer. Mostly.

items.name: Wraith-Ward Bracer
items.lore: Iron and rowan, against things that come out of the dark.

items.name: Border-Stone Charm
items.lore: A chip off the Forest Gate's stones. It hums near the Cursed Forest.

items.name: Empyrean Shard Charm
items.lore: A shard of an empyrean sentinel. Sky-blue, and it whistles in the wind.

items.name: Cold-Wind Ring
items.lore: Frost forms on it, even in summer.

items.name: Keeper's Sky-Blue Belt
items.lore: Rasa's own. Sky-blue, embroidered with clouds.

items.name: Freed-Keeper Bracer
items.lore: From the door of Rasa's hut, where she held out a month.

items.name: Empyrean-Song Torc
items.lore: Rasa hums the empyreans' song into it. It hums it back.

items.name: Hru's Stone-Guard Ring
items.lore: From Guardian Hru's own stones. It's heavier than a ring should be.

items.name: Wind-Freed Bracer
items.lore: An empyrean bracer, Fuamnach's wind sung out of it.

items.name: Overseer Niy's Crest
items.lore: Niy's crest of office. The wind still whistles through it, but it's only wind now.

items.name: Eye-of-the-Ridge Ring
items.lore: Niy saw the whole valley from that ridge. So does this ring, a little.

items.name: Ridge-Wind Cloak
items.lore: It flaps in a wind that isn't blowing.

items.name: Fuamnach's Rowan Rod
items.lore: The rod Fuamnach struck Etain with, a thousand years ago. Rowan. Rasa says the rowan was always meant to be on our side.

items.name: Eye-of-the-Wind Cloak
items.lore: Grey as a storm, and very still.

items.name: Jealous Wife's Ring
items.lore: Gold, with a scarlet stone that never stops moving.

items.name: Stilled-Wind Bracer
items.lore: The wind can't get past it.
